## `client.task_tokens`

The `task-tokens` resource of the platform API.

### `client.task_tokens.mint`

Signature: `client.task_tokens.mint(principal: str, environment: str, asset_scope: list[str], ttl_seconds: int) -> MintedTaskToken`

Mint a task token.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The identity the token authenticates as: your own name, unless you hold the `ADMIN` role on the instance. |
| `environment` | `str` | required | The one environment this task may touch. |
| `asset_scope` | `list[str]` | required | The declared asset name/pattern strings, e.g. `["bronze.*"]`. |
| `ttl_seconds` | `int` | required | Seconds until the token expires, from now. Capped server-side by the deployment's configured maximum. |

Returns: `MintedTaskToken`. The full token value — shown here exactly once.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no principal of this name exists. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If minting for another principal without the `ADMIN` role. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `asset_scope` contains a malformed pattern, or `ttl_seconds` exceeds the deployment's configured maximum. |

### `client.task_tokens.revoke`

Signature: `client.task_tokens.revoke(key_id: str) -> None`

Revoke a task token before it expires; revoking one already revoked is a no-op.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key_id` | `str` | required | The task token's key_id. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no task token has this key_id. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the caller may not mint task tokens. |
